changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: One row per wallet that has at least one ACTIVE holding: how many, what they cost and what they are worth (issue #242). A wallet with none has no row, so consumers LEFT JOIN it and coalesce the count and the invested total. current_value keeps SUM without COALESCE on purpose: a wallet whose holdings are all unpriced reports a null value, which is what makes the client render an em dash instead of a misleading zero. gain and gain_pct follow holdings_overview: null where the value is null, and gain_pct is null where nothing was invested, rounding the ratio to ten places before scaling by 100.
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW finances.wallet_totals AS SELECT totals.wallet_id, totals.holding_count, totals.total_invested, totals.current_value, totals.current_value - totals.total_invested AS gain, CASE WHEN totals.total_invested <> 0 THEN ROUND((totals.current_value - totals.total_invested) / totals.total_invested, 10) * 100 END AS gain_pct FROM ( SELECT wallet_id, COUNT(*) AS holding_count, COALESCE(SUM(cost_basis), 0) AS total_invested, SUM(current_value) AS current_value FROM finances.holdings_overview WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY wallet_id ) AS totals;
